name: Sonnet growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Round 2: rotate into quality mega-cap and select mid-cap growth names trading at reasonable multiples relative to durable earnings growth, add small-cap breadth exposure, stay out of crypto's ongoing bear market, and hedge frothy speculative excess with a modest short.

Still cheapest mega-cap grower on PEG; Q2 revenue beat (+24% YoY) though capex-hike concerns capped the pop. Held at weight -- thesis intact, no reason to chase or cut.
AI infra/custom-silicon compounder holding up near highs despite today's broad tech selloff; Samsung pact expands TAM. Held at weight.

Revenue/EPS beat but soft guidance and shrinking FCF on AI capex spooked the market (-7.5% AH); trimming rather than exiting since the ad-engagement growth story is still real, just less 'reasonable' near-term.
Small-cap breadth rotation intact; near 52-wk highs before today's market-wide 1.6% pullback on the hawkish Fed hold. Held at weight.
GARP turnaround confirmed -- shares near $420 vs. the depressed sub-$235 low the position was built against, Q2 net income +61% YoY. Adding modestly to a working thesis.
Steady membership compounder near 52-wk highs ahead of Q4 print; defensive ballast against the AI-capex-driven tech volatility. Held at weight.
Cheap cash-flow yield energy diversifier near 52-wk highs; Q2 earnings 7/31 is a near-term catalyst but position is a long-term GARP hold, not a trade. Held at weight.

Trimmed modestly -- leveraged Nasdaq beta adds decay/cost drag and amplified downside into a volatile post-Fed, post-earnings tape; kept small rather than removed since underlying mega-cap AI theses (MSFT especially) just got a fundamental boost.

Crypto bear market continues to confirm (COIN -29% YTD, -19.6% over 6mo, -4.6% today); increasing the hedge modestly while keeping it sized as a hedge, not a core short, consistent with the GARP mandate's 'modest' framing.
